result.title: Spherical Geometry-Aware Panoptic Scene Graph Generation for Equirectangular Panoramas
result.summary: Panoptic scene graph generation (PSGG) represents scene entities with segmentation masks and directed relations. Equirectangular projection (ERP) panoramas challenge PSGG through distortion, latitude-dependent pixel areas, and an artificial seam. We propose a two-stage spherical geometry-aware framework that fuses overlapping perspective-view predictions using observation reliability, spherical overlap, and angular proximity. Relation reasoning combines spherical-area-aware aggregation, weighted no-relation supervision, and dual-longitude score fusion. We also construct a dataset of 340 high-resolution panoramas with 10,571 nodes and 6,632 directed relations. Against corresponding baselines, spherical fusion improves PQ by 36.03% under matched views, while relation reasoning improves mR@50 by 11.20% under PredCls with ground-truth masks and object labels. The full framework improves mR@50 by 52.99% under SGDet with predicted panoptic segments. These results demonstrate the value of spherical geometry for panoramic PSGG.

AI.brief_summary: 面向等距柱状投影全景图的全景场景图生成，提出两阶段球面几何感知框架：依观测可靠性、球面重叠与角度邻近融合多个透视视图预测，并在关系推理中引入球面面积感知聚合、加权无关系监督与双经度分数融合，同时构建 340 幅全景图数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其按可靠性与重叠度加权融合多视角预测、并抑制虚假关系的做法，可供核查是否用于 latent 推理中多源视觉证据的筛选与聚合。
